metaDescription: Forever Lights won London's 2026 Permanent Outdoor Lighting award. See the colour-matched LED track system, boom lift install and 5-year warranty.
summary: Forever Lights installs permanent outdoor LED track lighting for homes and businesses in London, Ontario and the surrounding region, controlled entirely from a smartphone app. The system is colour-matched to soffits and fascia so the hardware is meant to disappear during the day.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Forever Lights installs a permanent LED lighting system once, with fixtures that stay in place year-round rather than being put up and taken down seasonally. Colour-matching the track to the home's existing soffit and fascia is a specific design step meant to keep the hardware inconspicuous in daylight. From the app, homeowners can switch between warm white ambiance, accent colours and full holiday light sequences without touching the physical fixtures.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Installation is handled by a professional crew using a 50-foot boom lift, which allows the team to reach higher rooflines than a standard ladder-based crew. Every installation is backed by a 5-year parts warranty, which is a meaningful commitment for a system meant to be a one-time install. Because the lighting is permanent, there is no annual re-installation cost after the initial project.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One customer described the boom-lift install as a breeze thanks to the professional crew, adding the home looks stunning year-round without touching a ladder since. Another said the family used to spend a whole weekend hanging Christmas lights and now changes the display in about ten seconds from their phone, with neighbours frequently asking who installed it.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Forever Lights is based in London and serves London and the surrounding region, including reviews from as far as Woodstock. Homeowners should confirm coverage of their specific address, since permanent lighting installs typically require an in-person site visit.

strengths: Permanent, app-controlled LED system removes the need for seasonal ladder work entirely.
Precision colour-matching to soffit and fascia is designed to keep hardware inconspicuous by day.
50-foot boom lift enables clean installation on higher or steeper rooflines.
5-year parts warranty backs a system meant to be a one-time investment.
considerations: Permanent lighting is a larger upfront investment than seasonal light rental or installation.
Best suited to homeowners planning to stay in the property long enough to use the multi-year warranty.
Installation requires boom-lift access, so site conditions like tight lot lines are worth discussing upfront.
bestFor: Homeowners who want year-round accent lighting without seasonal setup
Anyone tired of annual ladder work for holiday lights
Buyers wanting one system for everyday ambiance and holiday themes
Homes with soffit and fascia lines suited to track lighting
questionsToAsk: How is the track colour-matched to my specific soffit and fascia colour?
What does the 5-year parts warranty cover, and what would void it?
Can the system run holiday sequences alongside everyday warm-white lighting?
What site conditions are needed for the boom lift, and is there an alternative for tight access?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Forever Lights was selected as the top business in the Permanent Outdoor Lighting category for London through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: How is this different from seasonal Christmas light installation?
faq.a: The LED track is installed once and left in place year-round, controlled from a smartphone app, rather than being hung and taken down each holiday season by a crew.

faq.q: Can it still be used for Christmas?
faq.a: Yes. Reviewers describe switching to holiday colour sequences from the app in seconds, alongside everyday warm-white or accent lighting settings.
The company backs installations with a 5-year parts warranty, according to its listed service description.
